reason: This changes the concurrency model of `IndexLookUp` execution in core executor code (`pkg/executor/distsql.go`). Even with only a few files touched, moving idxlookup workers into a pool can affect runtime correctness, ordering/coordination, cancellation, resource reuse, and leak/deadlock behavior on a widely used execution path. That is central and risky enough to justify a focused deep review for High-severity executor issues.
